title: #168 Educational Purpose
prompt: Some people think the purpose of education is to have a better life in the future; others argue that it is only for self-improvement. What is your opinion? Your essay should base on your own experiences and examples.

promptSegments.text: Some people think the purpose of education is to have a better life in the future
others argue that it is only for self-improvement.
Your essay should base on your own experiences and examples.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Sử dụng các dẫn chứng thực tế thuyết phục để củng cố luận điểm.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Education provides useful skills necessary for securing better jobs and achieving a better career in the future.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Education provides useful skills necessary for securing better jobs and achieving a better career in the future.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Beyond career benefits, education improves thinking abilities, enabling people to make better and smarter life choices.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Beyond career benefits, education improves thinking abilities, enabling people to make better and smarter life choices.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Education is crucial for securing better jobs and achieving a comfortable life, as demonstrated by the example of learning computer skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Education is crucial for securing better jobs and achieving a comfortable life, as demonstrated by the example of learning computer skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Beyond career prospects, education is vital for self-improvement, providing knowledge (like health information) that helps people live longer and better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Beyond career prospects, education is vital for self-improvement, providing knowledge (like health information) that helps people live longer and better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Education provides the necessary skills for better jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Education provides the necessary skills for better jobs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Education helps people improve their lives through career advancement.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Education helps people improve their lives through career advancement.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Education equips individuals with practical skills, such as coding, which increases their chances of securing good employment and achieving a successful career.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Education equips individuals with practical skills, such as coding, which increases their chances of securing good employment and achieving a successful career.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, education aids self-understanding by allowing students to explore various subjects, helping them discover passions and feel more confident in their abilities and goals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, education aids self-understanding by allowing students to explore various subjects, helping them discover passions and feel more confident in their abilities and goals.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ diễn đạt lại đề bài mà quên khẳng định rõ lập trường cá nhân ở cả mở bài và kết bài.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh dùng các câu văn mẫu học thuộc lòng chung chung và các ý lạc đề.
